trials.submitted_answer: To determine the glass transition temperature (Tg), calculate the derivative of density with respect to temperature and identify the point where the slope changes significantly.

arguments.content:
units metal
atom_style full
read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SiO2.tersoff Si O
fix 1 all npt temp 5000 1500 3.5 iso 0.0 0.0 1000
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp density
run 10000
